text: The future of AI is a popular topic today. Most artificial intelligence we use now is "narrow" AI, which can only do one task well. However, many researchers are working on general AI, also called AGI, which could understand and learn any task like a human. AGI could bring great benefits, such as solving problems in medicine and science. Yet it also carries serious risks, like losing control or causing job losses. Experts disagree about when AGI might arrive; some say in ten years, while others think it is much further away. Either way, we need careful rules to use AI safely.
